title: feat(gen): add a minimal sitemap for the public pages
author: patbing

gist.summary: Added /sitemap.xml to the gen worker, listing only its two public HTML pages: / and /docs. robots.txt now points to the sitemap. Both files use the request’s public origin, so their URLs match the environment; the sitemap is served as XML with a one-hour public cache.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel garden, Polli pins a tiny sitemap showing two paths, / and /docs, beside a retro terminal while flowers grow along the paths. Polli is a small cute pixel art bee with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small happy smile, rounded light blue translucent wings, and a tiny cartographer’s hat; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green #ecf874 and dark purple #110518 details.
